issues.description: Pneumatic.raisePressure has a return type mismatch: the UML/problem statement defines `raisePressure(int pressureIncrease): void`, but the solution repository declares `boolean raisePressure(int pressureIncrease)`. This changes the required interface contract and will break/contradict tests and student implementations that follow the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution repository to match the UML: in `Pneumatic`, declare `void raisePressure(int pressureIncrease);` and update `LaunchedDropdownTower` and `LaunchedRollerCoaster` overrides to return `void` accordingly.
